provider: Synthesized locally with SoX 14.4 and encoded with FFmpeg libvorbis (q 5). No external service or sample library.

heartbeat.ogg.use: Critical health: a slow two-beat pulse while the Mother has one organelle left.
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 lub.wav synth 0.20 sine 62:44 fade q 0.008 0.20 0.16 gain -2
sox -n -r 44100 -c 1 dub.wav synth 0.17 sine 54:40 fade q 0.008 0.17 0.14 gain -5
sox lub.wav gap.wav dub.wav tail.wav beat-dry.wav
sox beat-dry.wav -c 2 heartbeat.wav gain -8 lowpass 180 reverb 18 50 60 gain -n -3

swell.ogg.use: A soft water swell when an encounter opens and when a new dish or boss is introduced.
commands: sox -n -r 44100 -c 2 swell-dry.wav synth 2.2 brownnoise synth 2.2 sine amod 0.35 0
sox swell-dry.wav swell.wav sinc 140-1100 fade q 0.9 2.2 1.1 reverb 40 60 80 gain -n -6
